blocks.text: DETROIT— Scottie Barnes scored 29 points, including a layup with 14 seconds left, and the Toronto Raptors ended their six-game losing streak with a 105-102 win over the Detroit Pistons in an NBA Cup game on Friday night. Toronto, which led by as many as 14, got the ball after a Detroit turnover with the score tied at 99. Barnes missed a driving layup, but Jakob Poeltl tipped it in to put the Raptors up 101-99 with 27.1 seconds to play.
